roles.coordinate_inputs: Two supplied absolute errors for fixed real true/estimated quantile coordinates.
roles.derived_error_interval: Algebra and triangle inequality give error at most epsilonA+epsilonB.
roles.derived_positive_direction: Strictly larger measured shift than the summed actual errors implies positive true shift.
roles.sharpness: Four strictly positive coordinates attain the summed bound; no density or posterior is constructed.
roles.risk_inputs: A common measurable space, measure and supplied marginal failure bounds; probabilities require a probability law.
roles.derived_risk: Paired failure is contained in the marginal union, so measure subadditivity gives summed risk.
roles.measurability: Measurable estimators give a measurable paired-failure event.
roles.absent_inputs: MCSE is not an absolute error or calibrated failure probability; no sampler or physical error bridge is supplied.
roles.false_targets: Imported sum mechanism accepts a sharp witness; max, quadrature and non-strict sign margin are refuted on it.
